response.rationale: Both answers match the cue and sense. “Kram menstruasi” is established Indonesian usage, while “senggugut” is the standard Malaysian Malay term for menstrual pain. The contrast is valid as a common lexical preference, though alternatives such as “sakit haid” also occur in both varieties. No false-friend issue is present.
